name: Oil
author: E. T. Carter
description: Iridescent oil on dark water: a drifting film whose thickness maps through interference orders into soft spectral sheen, so broad concentric zones of teal, magenta and gold flex slowly across the frame. A restrained rainbow that only ever cycles the theme colours, brightest along the constructive-interference fringes and never the same shape twice.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Pace of the drifting film — the sheen flexes slowly at the low end and visibly streams at the high end; 0 holds it as a still slick.

params.label: Sheen scale
params.effect: CSS-pixel size of the iridescent zones, from a fine busy oil-skin to a few broad sweeping sheets of colour.

params.label: Iridescence
params.effect: How many interference orders cross the film — low gives wide soft single-hue sweeps, high stacks dense rainbow fringes.

params.label: Sheen warp
params.effect: Turbulence of the film — low keeps the zones smooth and lazy, high churns them into tight folded marbled swirls.
